Dialga's and Palkia's spaces: Team Rocket catches Dialga and Palkia (story)
Dialga, Palkia and Giratina: catch them (after Lance's visit)

acquisitions.place: Dialga’s space — Ice Path B2F statue
acquisitions.conditions: After the final Hall of Fame and Lance’s visit to your house in Pallet Town. Carry the Adamant Orb to the Ice Path B2F statue to enter Dialga’s space. One chance: catching it, knocking it out or fleeing removes it; only losing allows a retry.
